notes.title: July Update!
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45232350/6db42ea9dba888fdd6928d0b206d2c262602833e.png"][/img][/p][h1]SPoOoOoOKinEsS IN JULY?!?![/h1][p][/p][p]That's right! A new HANGMAN update is here :D[/p][p][/p][p]Our resident programmer, Wilder, worked on updating quite a few things in the game! (We promise this was of his own accord---we do NOT have him chained to a desk, we swear o.O) [/p][p][/p][h2]Build V3.4 Updates[/h2][p]This latest update includes...[/p][list][*][p]An options button in the Main Menu[/p][/*][*][p]Fullscreen and Windowed options for both the Main Menu and Pause Menu[/p][/*][*][p]Random Word Mode is now more noticeable[/p][/*][*][p]In Random Word Mode, the full word is now revealed at the end of each round, regardless of loss or win[/p][/*][*][p]20 more words in Random Word Mode! (Word Pack #2)[/p][/*][*][p]Update to the profanity filter[/p][/*][*][p]Slightly faster movement speed in Random Word Mode[/p][/*][*][p]Subtle audio indication of secret level entrance location[/p][/*][*][p]'Locked gate' sound if the secret level entrance is approached after losing all limbs[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]More achievements :D[/h2][p][/p][p]On top of all these updates in the build, we also have [b]brand new achievements![/b][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45232350/2c072338d9a72a80419c4dca60261582017e65e8.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Are you able to unlock them all?![/b][/p][p][/p][h2]...and more to come.[/h2][p][/p][p]Keep an eye out for any future updates or patches for the game! As well as new PiPo releases 👀[/p][p][/p][p]If you'd like to keep up to date with our other projects, feel free to join the [url="https://discord.gg/CmBu7Ywzm4" buttoncolor="#ff3333"]Discord server[/url] and donate to our [url="https://https://ko-fi.com/pixelpoxet" buttoncolor="#f72222"]Ko-Fi[/url] if you'd like to support us![/p][p][/p][p]Happy spelling ;)[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45232350/e3568c444489700e53c1271db88dc2cb5ed9b2ce.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Week 1 Patch
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] 7 New Steam Achievements
[*] 25 New words for Random Mode
[*] Volume button
[*] New sounds and indicators
[*] Small thank you to our supporters!
[*] Minor fixes
[/list]

If you'd like to know more, read about it in our devlog!
